title: The Great Wall Isn't One Wall — It's 21,196 km | China Travel Expert
description:
You picture one long wall. It's actually 21,196 kilometers of them.

In 2012, China's National Cultural Heritage Administration finished a six-year survey and put the total length of every surviving Great Wall — walls, trenches and forts, built by more than 20 dynasties over 2,000 years — at 21,196.18 km. That's more than half the Earth's circumference. The best-preserved Ming-dynasty stretch alone runs 8,851.8 km.

🧭 Expert Tip: The crowded postcard section is Badaling. For the same views with room to breathe, go to Mutianyu — restored, cable-car access, far thinner crowds.

长城不是一道墙，是二十多个朝代修了两千年的 21,196 公里。
